purpose: Authoritative source map for industrial-site diligence. Public evidence improves screening direction but never constitutes utility serviceability, available headroom, treatment capacity, pressure, redundancy, route diversity or delivery timing.

power.name: EIA Form 861
power.use: Utility identity, customers, sales, reliability and service context.

power.name: EIA Form 860
power.use: Generation assets and planned generator context; not distribution headroom.

power.name: MISO interconnection queue
power.use: Regional generation/interconnection queue context only; not parcel serviceability.

power.name: PJM interconnection queues
power.use: Regional queue and grid-development context only; not parcel serviceability.

water.name: USGS Water Data for the Nation
water.use: Observed surface-water, groundwater and hydrologic context.

water.name: EPA drinking-water dashboard
water.use: Public water-system identity and regulatory context.

wastewater.name: EPA ICIS-NPDES discharge points
wastewater.use: Permits, outfalls, coordinates and reported design-flow fields where available.

wastewater.name: EPA ECHO
wastewater.use: Wastewater permit, compliance and regulated-facility evidence.

gas.name: National Pipeline Mapping System
gas.use: Transmission-pipeline corridor context; no assumption of tap availability or pressure.

fiber.name: FCC National Broadband Map
fiber.use: Reported fixed-broadband availability at location level.

environmental.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
environmental.use: Flood-hazard screening; local map amendments and site engineering still require review.

environmental.name: National Wetlands Inventory
environmental.use: Wetland screening; not a jurisdictional determination.

transport.name: National Transportation Atlas Database
transport.use: National freight, road, rail, port and intermodal infrastructure context.

transport.name: FRA Crossing Inventory
transport.use: Rail crossing and network context; not rail service commitment.

adversarial_tests: Increase all project utility loads by 15%.
Increase all project utility loads by 30%.
Compress required online date by 6 months.
Combine 30% load growth with a 9-month schedule compression.
Assume the strongest unverified dependency fails until written proof exists.
release_gates: Resolve exact parcel and serving authority before treating territory as known.
Require a written utility or authority response before converting modeled headroom to verified capacity.
Keep observed/reported source dates distinct from retrieval dates.
Do not infer serviceability from proximity to a line, plant, outfall, substation, pipeline, roadway, rail line or fiber route.
Do not infer redundant service from multiple nearby assets or providers.
For high-load projects, preserve study and upgrade lead time as unknown until the serving utility provides it.
Environmental and transportation sources can create diligence flags but cannot improve utility feasibility scores.
